factsheet.heading: Family Day in the City - Hop on, hop off Walking Tour
paragraphs: We want Open House to be easy for everyone to enjoy, young and old.
Head to Guildhall Art Gallery and London’s Roman Amphitheatre on 12 September for an Open House experience made just for families.

Hop aboard our walking bus tour for fun facts and sensational stories as we wonderfully wind through the City of London to three more City sites with family offers – London Mithraeum Bloomberg SPACE, St Paul’s Cathedral and Dr Johnson’s House.
